becomeAPartner.metaTitle: Become a Bus Operator Partner — Moja Ride
becomeAPartner.metaDescription: Grow your bus fleet revenue with Moja Ride. Fill empty seats, automate terminal ticketing, and accept automated mobile money payouts across Côte d'Ivoire.
becomeAPartner.shellTitle: Grow Your Fleet Revenue & Automate Operations
becomeAPartner.shellDescription: Join Côte d'Ivoire's premier intercity transport network. Sell tickets online and at counters, manage multi-terminal operations, and get daily direct payouts.
becomeAPartner.pillarsTitle: Everything You Need to Scale Your Transport Business
becomeAPartner.pillar1Desc: Reach thousands of passengers searching routes online daily. Fill unsold seats before departure.
becomeAPartner.pillar2Desc: Issue physical or digital tickets at your terminals while keeping seat inventory synced live across all channels.
becomeAPartner.pillar3Desc: Receive direct daily settlements straight to your company Bank Account or Mobile Money (Orange, MTN, Wave).
becomeAPartner.pillar4Desc: Manage station clerks, accountants, and dispatchers with granular permissions and detailed activity logs.
becomeAPartner.stepsDesc: Our guided onboarding wizard makes setting up your transport company effortless.
becomeAPartner.step1Desc: Enter legal business details, tax ID (IFU/NCC), and headquarter location.
becomeAPartner.step2Desc: Upload your RCCM trade register, transport license, and manager ID.
becomeAPartner.step3Desc: Connect your corporate bank account or Mobile Money merchant account.
becomeAPartner.step4Desc: Set up your operator branding, primary contact details, and preferences.
becomeAPartner.step5Desc: Review terms, accept the partnership agreement, and launch your routes!
becomeAPartner.checklistTitle: What You'll Need Before You Register
becomeAPartner.checklistDesc: Gather these items to breeze through document verification in one go.
becomeAPartner.check1: Official Trade Register (RCCM / Registre du Commerce)
becomeAPartner.check2: Valid Transport Permit or License (Agrément de Transport)
becomeAPartner.check3: Tax Identification Number (NCC / N° Compte Contribuable)
becomeAPartner.check4: National ID or Passport of Legal Representative
becomeAPartner.check5: Corporate Bank RIB or Verified Mobile Money Merchant Number
becomeAPartner.faq1Q: How quickly can my company start selling tickets on Moja Ride?
becomeAPartner.faq1A: Once you complete the 5-step registration and submit your verification documents, our onboarding team reviews your account within 24 hours.
becomeAPartner.faq2Q: Can our station clerks still sell cash tickets at counter desks?
becomeAPartner.faq2A: Yes! Moja Ride includes a station counter desk tool so your clerks can issue tickets locally while keeping online inventory perfectly synchronized.
becomeAPartner.faq3Q: How are ticket sales paid out to our company?
becomeAPartner.faq3A: Payouts are processed automatically via bank transfer or Mobile Money (Orange, MTN, Wave) according to your preferred daily or weekly payout cycle.
becomeAPartner.faq4Q: Are there setup fees or hidden costs?
becomeAPartner.faq4A: No. Registration is 100% free with no setup fees. We operate on a transparent performance model only.
becomeAPartner.closingTitle: Ready to Scale Your Bus Transport Operations?
becomeAPartner.closingDesc: Join Moja Ride today and experience the future of intercity transport management.

about.shellTitle: Connecting Côte d'Ivoire, One Journey at a Time
about.shellDescription: Moja Ride was born from a simple belief: traveling between cities in Côte d'Ivoire should be easy, safe, and dignified. We built the platform to give passengers real choice and to help bus operators reach more customers.
about.missionBody1: To become the most trusted intercity transport marketplace in West Africa — making bus travel as simple and accessible as booking a taxi, while giving operators the tools to run better businesses.
about.missionBody2: We're starting in Côte d'Ivoire and will expand across the region as we grow. Every decision we make is guided by one question: “Does this make the journey better?”
about.value1Desc: Every operator on Moja Ride is verified and must meet strict safety and insurance standards before serving passengers.
about.value2Desc: We believe every traveler deserves a comfortable, stress-free journey — from booking to arrival.
about.value3Desc: No hidden fees. The price you see is the price you pay. Our commission model ensures fair deals for passengers and operators.
about.cta1Desc: Search hundreds of routes and book your next trip in minutes.
about.cta2Desc: Join our network and reach thousands of new passengers.
